response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience and exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP protocols, but lacks clear evidence of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, direct experience with vector databases or RAG architectures, and leadership in customer-facing technical discovery — key requirements for a Staff-level GenAI role.
strengths: Experienced with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling
Proven track record in building scalable systems across cloud (AWS) and distributed architectures
Active open-source contributor with demonstrated technical leadership and mentoring via workshops
concerns: No explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization in experience
Lack of documented enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or consulting engagements
Education shows only a BS; no advanced degree or formal AI/ML specialization highlighted
